text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple paragraphs with topic sentence and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"This captures clearer overall structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and a concluding paragraph."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like \"One way,\" \"Another way,\" and \"A final way\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures stronger linking of ideas across paragraphs and within the argument."},{"evidence":"\"for example\" followed by specific situations like college, sport, and car decisions","quality":"elaboration","description":"This captures fuller support for ideas through relevant examples and explanation."},{"evidence":"\"help alleviate all that stress\" and \"make a better choice\"","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures more extended development of a central claim rather than a simple list of related ideas."},{"evidence":"mostly complete sentences with few distracting errors","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures better command of sentence boundaries and grammatical structure."},{"evidence":"\"advise\" repeated in formal argument","quality":"academic style","description":"This captures a more essay-like, persuasive register that is more appropriate for school writing."}]}
